title: Xtra Power Chain Saw File with Handle, 4mm Size, Pack of 3
description: The Xtra Power Chain Saw File with Handle is an essential tool for maintaining and sharpening your chainsaw blades with precision and ease. This set comes with 3 pieces of 4mm files, making it a practical choice for both professional users and DIY enthusiasts. The ergonomic handle provides a comfortable and firm grip, allowing for better control and accuracy while filing. The 4mm size is ideal for sharpening standard chainsaw chains, ensuring your saw remains in peak working condition. Each file is crafted from durable material that delivers consistent performance, helping to extend the life of your chainsaw chain. Whether you are a woodcutter, landscaper, or simply maintaining your garden equipment, this chain saw file set is a reliable companion. The compact size makes it easy to carry in your tool kit or store in your workshop. Keep your chainsaw sharp and ready for use with this handy 3-piece file set.
